list: Official 55-trophy identity fields supplied with the GTA VI Trophy Guide kit.
note: Official names, descriptions, and grades are reproduced from the supplied list. Route placement, time, difficulty, and guide advice are editorial planning estimates, not verified game data.

phases.name: First Light
phases.goal: Complete the opening mission and establish the story route.
phases.about: Start with the required opening beat so every later story milestone has a clear starting point. Optional exploration can wait until the campaign opens the wider map.

phases.name: The Main Story
phases.goal: Work through Chapters 1–4 and the final mission.
phases.about: Group the campaign milestones together before the open-world checklist. This keeps mission progression in one uninterrupted block and postpones optional cleanup until the route is free to roam.

phases.name: People of Leonida
phases.goal: Finish stranger strands and their associated activities.
phases.about: Strand work is easier to track when handled as a focused sweep. The estimates are planning aids; use the game’s own activity and completion screens to confirm any count.

phases.name: Street-Level Work
phases.goal: Clear robberies, wanted-level challenges, and other crime-focused objectives.
phases.about: Batch the listed crime objectives together so each session can focus on one kind of preparation. Check every condition in the official description before attempting a challenge.

phases.name: Games and Challenges
phases.goal: Sample activities, races, ranges, and repeatable skill checks.
phases.about: This phase combines activity introductions with medal and cumulative goals. Keep a simple checklist for objectives that do not expose an obvious single counter.

phases.name: Across Leonida
phases.goal: Explore the map and complete broad world-sweep objectives.
phases.about: A region-by-region sweep reduces backtracking and gives the map checklist a clear structure. Recheck the in-game tracker before assuming that a discovery or collection total is complete.

phases.name: Collection and Completion
phases.goal: Finish collection sets and audit the overall completion tracker.
phases.about: Save count-heavy and checklist-based tasks for a deliberate cleanup pass. This order is a convenience, not a claim that the game requires it.

phases.name: Final Check
phases.goal: Confirm every remaining requirement and earn the platinum trophy.
phases.about: The platinum is the capstone rather than a separate activity. Compare the console trophy list with your own ticks and let the final requirement trigger the award.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.requires: All other trophies in this list.
steps: Earn each of the other trophies.
Compare the console trophy list against your progress ticks.
Confirm the platinum entry after the final unlock.
trophies.guide: This is the capstone for the complete trophy list. It is awarded after the other listed trophies have been earned. Keep the console trophy screen as the final source of truth.
trophies.hint: Review the complete trophy list before the last cleanup session.
trophies.verification: Confirm that the platinum entry appears in the console trophy list.
sources: Official GTA VI trophy list supplied with the kit.
Trophy Atlas route notes; estimates are editorial.

Follow the objectives for Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission and confirm the unlock.
trophies.guide: This trophy names the opening mission as its requirement. Follow the objectives presented by the game and finish the mission. The official description does not add a medal or optional condition.
trophies.hint: Use the campaign mission marker to begin.
trophies.verification: Check the trophy list after completing Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.requires: Complete the content counted by the in-game completion tracker.
steps: Open the in-game completion tracker and note its categories.
Work through each category, checking progress as you go.
Continue until the tracker reports 100% completion.
trophies.guide: This trophy asks for the game’s 100% completion state. The in-game tracker is the practical checklist because the short official description does not enumerate its categories. Review the tracker regularly and use it to direct the remaining cleanup.
trophies.hint: Use the in-game completion tracker as your authoritative checklist.
trophies.verification: Confirm the game’s completion tracker reaches 100% and check for the trophy unlock.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.requires: No listed prerequisite; the route groups this with repeatable activities.
steps: Check the game’s stats for the current stunt total.
Complete stunts during ordinary travel when convenient.
Continue until the total reaches 250.
trophies.guide: The stated target is 250 completed stunts. Keep an eye on the game’s available statistics or counters to avoid estimating from memory. Treat the time estimate as a planning range rather than a measured completion time.
trophies.hint: Build progress over multiple sessions and recheck the available counter.
trophies.verification: Confirm the stunt total reaches 250 and the trophy registers.
sources: Official GTA VI trophy list supplied with the kit.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.requires: No listed prerequisite; activities must be available to try.
steps: Review the available activity types in the game.
Try each type at least once.
Revisit the activity list to spot any untried type.
trophies.guide: This is a breadth check across activity types rather than a single event. Use the game’s activity listings to build a personal checklist. The official wording does not specify a fixed number of types.
trophies.hint: Track the activity categories you have actually tried.
trophies.verification: Review your activity checklist and confirm the trophy unlocks after the last type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps: List each Shooting Range challenge shown in the game.
Earn a gold medal in every listed challenge.
Recheck the results screen for any challenge below gold.
trophies.guide: The requirement is a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Work one challenge at a time and use each result screen to identify remaining attempts. The official description does not state how many challenges are present.
trophies.hint: Use the range results to focus practice on challenges without gold.
trophies.verification: Confirm every challenge shows gold and check the trophy list.

steps: Record each Top Fun Drone Race location you find.
Win a race at every recorded location.
Revisit the list and confirm each location has a win.
trophies.guide: The trophy requires a win at every location, so distinguish locations rather than counting repeated wins at one course. Keep a location checklist as you discover races. The official description does not state a total number of locations.
trophies.hint: Track race locations individually; a repeat at one location does not replace another.
trophies.verification: Confirm each location has a win and check for the trophy unlock.

Win the event and note its identity on a checklist.
Repeat with different races until you have 20 wins.
trophies.guide: The important word is different: the target is twenty distinct races. Track event identities so that repeat attempts do not confuse your tally. Check the in-game record where available and use it alongside your notes.
trophies.hint: Spread wins across distinct events and keep a list of them.
trophies.verification: Confirm twenty different race wins and look for the trophy notification.

trophies.hint: Focus on the challenge’s result condition rather than fishing outside it.
trophies.verification: Confirm the result screen records a win over Cal and the trophy is earned.
